method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (16 Nov 2026 HKT): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD/LegCo, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 16 Nov 2026: OECD GloBE publications and news search, 18th plenary announcement (30 Oct) and statement PDF, GIR XML Schema v2.0 page, and September 2026 AG re-checked. No new model rules, AG, GIR, Central Record or Full Legislative Review since catalogued items (plenary 30 Oct; GIR XML Schema v2.0 20 Oct; Romania STTR 2 Oct). Latest AG remains September 2026. PwC Singapore international updates re-checked through 5 Nov (4 Nov Tax Certainty Day remains 2025 MAP/APA statistics, not a standalone GloBE document). No standalone OECD GloBE document published since the 30 Oct plenary statement.
coverage.HK: Checked 16 Nov 2026: IRD What's New and GMT/HKMTT page fetched; no new IRD What's New Pillar Two item after the catalogued 26 Oct Portal BIR82 filing / e-assessments (2–4 Nov entries remain CARF & Amended CRS, not Pillar Two). Added a missed official item: LC Paper No. CB(1)1388/2026(01) (FSTB/IRD paper to the LegCo Panel on Financial Affairs on subsidiary legislation to incorporate 2026 OECD GloBE documents, including the Side-by-Side package). Official PDF fetched and read; signed October 2026, PDF created 2 Nov 2026 HKT, HTTP Last-Modified 5 Nov 2026 02:56:52 GMT. PwC HK Tax News Flash Issue 19 (5 Nov) used as secondary discovery only. Legislation not yet gazetted (planned negative vetting Dec 2026, commencement Feb 2027).
coverage.SG: Checked 16 Nov 2026: IRAS Latest Updates (newest item still 12 Nov FEDR for self-employed/platform workers, not Pillar Two; latest Pillar Two e-Tax Guide still 30 Oct Third Edition), IRAS GloBE/DTT page, and PwC Singapore Tax News (latest SG Pillar Two entries remain 4 Nov Act 23 and 30 Oct Third Edition guide) fetched. Catalogued items unchanged: Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 (Act 23) published Acts Supplement 4 Nov; Third Edition e-Tax Guide (30 Oct); QTI/SBTI list (13 Oct). No new MMT Regulations for safe harbours; no new IRAS guidance or SSO MMT subsidiary legislation since 13 Nov.
coverage.JP: Checked 16 Nov 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched through 13 Nov (酒類の輸出動向). No Pillar Two items after the catalogued 21 Oct GIR AEOI partner list. 13 Nov sake-export statistics; 11 Nov driver recruitment; 9 Nov student tax-essay awards; 2 Nov tobacco hand-held stock tax; 30 Oct CbCR EOI partner-list update confirmed non-Pillar Two (CbCR ≠ GIR). GIR EOI hub still points to the October 2026 (令和8年10月) partner list. The 9 Oct 趣旨説明 remains catalogued but falls before the rolling 30-day window starting ~17 Oct. No new JP IIR/QDMTT/GIR administrative guidance. MOF search found no November 2026 Pillar Two publications.
